descripcion: Bus and taxi stops, station concourses, ticket gates, ticket machines and platforms, with their landmarks and warnings.

categorias.a_bordo: On board: bus, tram, metro and train

subcategorias.apoyos_plataformas: Leaning rails, platforms and bike stands

marquesina.descripcion: Bus shelter: a glass back wall with a bench and two side walls. You go in from the front; inside you are under cover.
marquesina.imagen: Footprint of “Bus shelter with bench”: a U open at the front, 4.00 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

marquesina_ele.descripcion: Shelter with a back and a single side wall, on the windward side. The other side is open.
marquesina_ele.imagen: Footprint of “L-shaped bus shelter”: an L shape: the back with the bench and a single side wall, on the left, 4.00 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

poste_parada.descripcion: Thin pole with the stop sign on top and, at chest height, the timetable frame.
poste_parada.imagen: Footprint of “Bus stop pole”: a circle, 0.10 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

panel_sonoro.descripcion: Post with a next-arrivals screen and a button at hand height: press it and it speaks the waiting times.
panel_sonoro.imagen: Footprint of “Talking information panel”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

poste_taxi.descripcion: Pole with the taxi sign. The cabs wait beside it with their engines running.
poste_taxi.imagen: Footprint of “Taxi rank pole”: a circle, 0.10 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Pt”.

apoyo_isquiatico.descripcion: Padded bar at hip height to lean on without sitting.
apoyo_isquiatico.imagen: Footprint of “Leaning rail”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Ai”.

aparcabicis.descripcion: A row of metal hoops with bikes locked to them, by the station. Wheels and handlebars stick out.
aparcabicis.imagen: Footprint of “Bike parking”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 3.00 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ap”.

plataforma_embarque.descripcion: A stretch of pavement raised above the rest so you board the bus without a step. You get on it by a gentle ramp.
plataforma_embarque.aviso: Bus stop platform: the ground ramps up.
plataforma_embarque.imagen: Footprint of “Raised boarding platform”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 8.00 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

maquina_billetes.descripcion: Ticket machine: a metal cabinet with a screen and keypad at chest height. The keys beep.
maquina_billetes.imagen: Footprint of “Ticket machine”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

mostrador_taquilla.descripcion: Ticket office window: a counter at chest height with a glass screen and a person behind it.
mostrador_taquilla.imagen: Footprint of “Ticket office counter”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

kiosco_informacion.descripcion: Round information desk in the middle of the concourse, with a person inside. You can walk all the way round.
kiosco_informacion.imagen: Footprint of “Information kiosk”: an octagon, 2.40 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ki”.

asientos_estacion.descripcion: Row of metal seats joined on a beam, with armrests between places. They do not move.
asientos_estacion.imagen: Footprint of “Row of station seats”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Ae”.

asientos_dobles.descripcion: Two rows of seats joined back to back, in the middle of the concourse: you can sit on either side.
asientos_dobles.imagen: Footprint of “Back-to-back seats”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ad”.

vending.descripcion: Drinks and snacks machine. It hums constantly: it tells you where the wall is.
vending.imagen: Footprint of “Vending machine”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Ve”.

papelera.descripcion: Hoop bin with a clear bag, at hip height.
papelera.imagen: Footprint of “Station litter bin”: a circle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

consigna.descripcion: A wall of metal lockers for leaving luggage. The doors open outwards.
consigna.imagen: Footprint of “Left-luggage lockers”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

maleta.descripcion: A suitcase someone has left beside them, in the way. Low and hard; on wheels.
maleta.imagen: Footprint of “Suitcase on the floor”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

carro_equipaje.descripcion: Metal trolley for suitcases, loose in the concourse. It rolls if pushed.
carro_equipaje.imagen: Footprint of “Luggage trolley”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.65 by 0.95 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

canceladora.descripcion: Post with a machine to validate your ticket or tap your card, at hand height. It beeps when it accepts.
canceladora.imagen: Footprint of “Ticket validator”: a rectangle, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

torno.descripcion: A ticket gate: a narrow metal body with an arm barring the way. Validate your ticket and it gives.
torno.imagen: Footprint of “Ticket gate”: an L shape, 0.80 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “To”.

tornos_fila.descripcion: A bank of ticket gates: several metal bodies in a row with narrow passages between them. You must validate for them to open.
tornos_fila.imagen: Footprint of “Row of ticket gates”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 3.20 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tf”.

puerta_acceso_ancha.descripcion: Wide passage for wheelchairs, pushchairs and guide dogs: two bodies at the sides and a leaf that opens when you validate.
puerta_acceso_ancha.imagen: Footprint of “Wide access gate”: two bodies at the sides joined by a thin leaf barring the way, 1.40 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

barandilla.descripcion: Tubular metal railing dividing two routes. You can follow it by hand; the cane passes under the top bar.
barandilla.imagen: Footprint of “Handrail”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.06 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

ascensor_exterior.descripcion: Glass housing of the lift down to the station. As an object it is a tall box; the door is at the front, with the button on the right.
ascensor_exterior.imagen: Footprint of “Street lift”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.00 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ae”.

banco_anden.descripcion: Metal bench with armrests, against the platform wall.
banco_anden.imagen: Footprint of “Platform bench”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

columna_anden.descripcion: Column holding up the roof, in the middle of the platform. There is usually one every few metres, in a row.
columna_anden.imagen: Footprint of “Platform column”: an octagon, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

borde_anden.descripcion: Strip of blisters along the platform edge. It does not block the way, but beyond it are the tracks: do not cross until the train has stopped.
borde_anden.aviso: Platform edge: stop. The tracks are beyond.
borde_anden.imagen: Footprint of “Platform edge with tactile strip”: a rectangle, 10.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

franja_guia.descripcion: Strip of raised bars leading from the concourse to the gates and the platform. Follow it with your foot or cane.
franja_guia.imagen: Footprint of “Tactile guidance strip”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Fg”.

cartel_colgante.descripcion: Illuminated sign hanging from the ceiling, sometimes too low: at head height for a tall person.
cartel_colgante.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging sign”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.85 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cc”.

reloj_estacion.descripcion: Large clock on the wall. It ticks: a landmark telling you which way the exit is.
reloj_estacion.imagen: Footprint of “Station clock”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.12 metres, hanging 2.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Re”.

cenicero.descripcion: Thin metal column with an ashtray on top, by the station door.
cenicero.imagen: Footprint of “Standing ashtray”: a circle, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

plano_tactil.descripcion: Sloping lectern with the station map in relief and braille, at hand height.
plano_tactil.imagen: Footprint of “Tactile map”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pt”.

interfono.descripcion: Post with a large button at chest height: press it and a person answers through the speaker.
interfono.imagen: Footprint of “Help point intercom”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “In”.

baliza_sonora.descripcion: Small box above a door that makes a sound so you can find it. It is not in the way: it is very high up.
baliza_sonora.imagen: Footprint of “Audible door beacon”: a rectangle, 0.25 by 0.10 metres, hanging 2.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bs”.

megafono.descripcion: Loudspeaker mounted high up. Every so often the announcement chime sounds: ding, dong, dang.
megafono.imagen: Footprint of “Public address speaker”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.25 metres, hanging 2.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Me”.

extintor.descripcion: Fire extinguisher hung on the wall one metre up. The cane passes under it.
extintor.imagen: Footprint of “Wall fire extinguisher”: a circle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ex”.

llamador_taxi.descripcion: Post with a large raised button at chest height and a speaker: press it and a voice confirms a taxi has been called to that rank. It stands next to the taxi rank sign.
llamador_taxi.imagen: Footprint of “Taxi call post”: a rectangle, 0.25 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Lt”.

eurotaxi_rampa.nombre: Accessible taxi with its rear ramp down
eurotaxi_rampa.descripcion: Taxi people carrier with the tailgate open and an aluminium ramp resting on the ground for a wheelchair to roll up. The ramp sticks out a metre and a half behind the car and has raised edges.
eurotaxi_rampa.imagen: Footprint of “Accessible taxi with its rear ramp down”: the outline of a car with its nose at the front and a narrower ramp sticking out at the back, 1.90 by 6.50 metres, marked with the letters “Er”.

parada_provisional.nombre: Temporary bus stop post on a base
parada_provisional.descripcion: Bus stop pole set in a concrete block or a wide, low rubber base, put out when the stop moves because of roadworks. The base sticks out around the pole at ankle height and is easy to trip on.
parada_provisional.imagen: Footprint of “Temporary bus stop post on a base”: a low square base with the pole in the middle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

escalera_mecanica.descripcion: Moving staircase between two rubber handrails that travel with it. At the entrance you feel a metal comb plate and the steps forming under your feet. Put your hand on the handrail before stepping on: that tells you whether it goes up or down. It rattles and hums: you hear it before you reach it.
escalera_mecanica.aviso: Escalator: hold the handrail and get ready for the step that forms.
escalera_mecanica.imagen: Footprint of “Escalator (section)”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 9.00 metres, marked with the letters “Em”.

puerta_autobus.descripcion: Two framed glass leaves that open with a puff of air after three beeps. In the middle or at the sides there are vertical poles to hold. In low-floor buses there is no step and the vehicle kneels towards the kerb.
puerta_autobus.imagen: Footprint of “Bus double door”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

puesto_conductor_bus.descripcion: Beside the front door: a chest-high glass screen with a gap to talk through, the change tray and the validator, which beeps when you tap your card. The driver sits behind it.
puesto_conductor_bus.imagen: Footprint of “Driver's cab with validator”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

mampara_puerta_bus.descripcion: Glass or acrylic panel separating the first seat from the door area, fixed to a pole. It leaves a gap at the bottom where the cane tip may slip under; you find it with your hand or knee.
mampara_puerta_bus.imagen: Footprint of “Glass screen beside the door”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.05 metres, hanging 0.15 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Mp”.

rampa_autobus.descripcion: Metal plate with non-slip rubber at the centre door, which the driver flips out onto the kerb with slow warning beeps. Unfolded it makes a short slope with raised edges; folded it is part of the floor and you feel its joints.
rampa_autobus.aviso: Bus ramp: the floor slopes down to the kerb.
rampa_autobus.imagen: Footprint of “Bus fold-out ramp”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ra”.

escalones_vehiculo.descripcion: High, narrow steps just inside the door of a coach or an old regional train, with a vertical grab handle on each side. The first is usually the highest; each step has a rough strip along its edge.
escalones_vehiculo.aviso: Door steps: hold the grab handle.
escalones_vehiculo.imagen: Footprint of “Steps inside the door”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ev”.

tarima_trasera_bus.nombre: Step up to the rear deck
tarima_trasera_bus.descripcion: In low-floor buses the rear section is higher: a step a hand's width high, sometimes with a short ramp, crosses the aisle. The last rows of seats are behind it.
tarima_trasera_bus.aviso: Step: the back of the bus is higher.
tarima_trasera_bus.imagen: Footprint of “Step up to the rear deck”: a rectangle, 2.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Tt”.

paso_rueda_bus.descripcion: Plastic-covered bulge over the wheel, against the side of the bus, at knee height. Raised seats are usually on top, reached by a small step. Walking down the aisle your knee bumps into it.
paso_rueda_bus.imagen: Footprint of “Wheel arch housing”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.80 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

plataforma_fuelle_bus.descripcion: In an articulated bus or tram, the round floor where the two sections join: a metal disc that turns under your feet on bends, with folded rubber walls at the sides that move. Better not to stand on it.
plataforma_fuelle_bus.aviso: Articulation: the floor turns on bends.
plataforma_fuelle_bus.imagen: Footprint of “Articulated bus turntable”: a circle, 1.20 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pf”.

escalera_dos_pisos.descripcion: Narrow, steep stairway, sometimes curving, up to the top deck of a sightseeing bus or a double-deck train. It has handrails on both sides and short treads; at the top the ceiling is low.
escalera_dos_pisos.aviso: Narrow stairs to the upper deck: hold both handrails.
escalera_dos_pisos.imagen: Footprint of “Stairs inside a double-deck vehicle”: an L shape, 0.60 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ed”.

barra_vertical_pulsador.descripcion: Smooth metal tube from floor to ceiling, as thick as a wrist, to hold while standing. At chest height it has a raised rectangular button: press it, a chime sounds and the stop-requested sign lights up.
barra_vertical_pulsador.imagen: Footprint of “Vertical pole with stop button”: a circle, 0.04 by 0.04 metres, marked with the letters “Bv”.

barra_techo_asideros.descripcion: Horizontal rail along the aisle, above head height, with plastic straps hanging from it that swing with the motion. A tall person can hit them with their forehead; the cane does not find them.
barra_techo_asideros.imagen: Footprint of “Ceiling rail with hanging straps”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.65 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bt”.

barra_arbol_metro.descripcion: Vertical pole in the middle of a metro or tram car that, halfway up, splits into three curved arms reaching the ceiling, so several people can hold on at once. It is slim at the bottom; higher up the arms take more room and your shoulder bumps them.
barra_arbol_metro.imagen: Footprint of “Branching centre pole”: a 3-pointed star, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

asientos_bus_pareja.descripcion: Two seats side by side facing forward, with a grab handle on top of the backrest for whoever sits behind. The window seat is against the side; the aisle seat is next to a pole.
asientos_bus_pareja.imagen: Footprint of “Pair of bus seats”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ab”.

asiento_reservado_bus.descripcion: Single seat near the door, reserved for older, pregnant or disabled passengers. The seat springs up on its own when you stand. There is a raised pictogram above it and, nearby, a lower stop button.
asiento_reservado_bus.imagen: Footprint of “Fold-up priority seat”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

zona_pmr_bus.descripcion: Opposite the centre door: a padded panel against the side wall at back height, with a horizontal rail and a low raised stop button. In front of it is a free space for a wheelchair or a pushchair.
zona_pmr_bus.imagen: Footprint of “Wheelchair space backrest”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.20 metres, hanging 0.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Zp”.

banco_longitudinal_metro.descripcion: Row of seats along the side of the car, backs to the windows and facing the aisle. The opposite bench is two steps away: knees nearly meet. The doors are between one bench and the next.
banco_longitudinal_metro.imagen: Footprint of “Longitudinal metro bench”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bl”.

cuarteto_asientos_tren.descripcion: Two pairs of train seats facing each other with a table between them by the window. The aisle side is open; sitting down, your knees touch the table and the knees opposite.
cuarteto_asientos_tren.imagen: Footprint of “Facing seats with table”: two rows of facing seats with a table between them by the window; the aisle side is open, 1.00 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

aviso_proxima_parada.descripcion: Screen hanging from the aisle ceiling with a speaker: before each stop two notes sound and a voice says its name. If it hangs mid-aisle, a tall person may hit it.
aviso_proxima_parada.imagen: Footprint of “Next stop display and speaker”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.95 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ap”.

martillo_emergencia.descripcion: Small plastic hammer with a steel point, in a holder by the emergency windows, at head height. You feel the point when you touch it; it comes out when pulled, sometimes setting off a beeping alarm. Emergencies only.
martillo_emergencia.imagen: Footprint of “Emergency glass hammer”: a rectangle, 0.08 by 0.05 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Me”.

freno_emergencia.descripcion: Handle in a box by the carriage door, behind a plastic flap you have to lift. Pulling it stops the train and alerts the driver over the intercom. Only in case of danger.
freno_emergencia.imagen: Footprint of “Emergency brake handle”: a rectangle, 0.20 by 0.08 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Fe”.

rejilla_equipaje.descripcion: Wire or glass shelf along the wall above the seats, for small cases and coats. When you stand up from your seat your head is right underneath: mind the edge and anything sticking out.
rejilla_equipaje.imagen: Footprint of “Overhead luggage rack”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.45 metres, hanging 1.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Re”.

maletero_tren.descripcion: Two- or three-tier rack by the coach entrance for large suitcases, with bars across the front to stop them falling. Cases often stick out into the aisle.
maletero_tren.imagen: Footprint of “Train luggage stack”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

aseo_tren.descripcion: Large cubicle with a sliding door opened by a big raised button and closed with another from inside. Inside are fold-down grab rails, a sensor basin and a vacuum toilet that flushes with a loud, sharp whoosh.
aseo_tren.imagen: Footprint of “Accessible train toilet”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.80 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “At”.

barra_cafeteria_tren.descripcion: Narrow counter on one side of the buffet car, with the attendant behind it and high ledges to lean on opposite, by the windows. The train sways: cups clink and it is wise to hold the edge.
barra_cafeteria_tren.imagen: Footprint of “Train café-bar counter”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.
